_comment: Dev-only local-development overlay. Copy this file to config/local-overrides.json (which is gitignored and MUST NOT be committed) and edit the paths. It maps a language to a local working-tree root the orchestrator uses in place of a clone, so `make orchestrate` runs your live local edits for that language while every other language is still a cached clone. Applies to any language except the own language of a context=language:<lang> run; wins over a configurationOverrides clone. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.
